einzeiler: Bobby and his lifelong friend Ahmad reflect on two decades of friendship and early life.
kurzfassung: Bobby and his longtime friend Ahmad sit down for a candid conversation about their shared history, dating back to their days in Austin and working together at a gym. They reminisce about early struggles, career milestones, personal growth, and navigating fatherhood later in life. The episode offers a deep, nostalgic look into a twenty-year bond built on mutual support and shared hardships.
stichpunkte: Bobby and Ahmad reflect on their 20-year friendship that began in Austin around 2003
Ahmad shares how Bobby was a primary catalyst who pushed him to finally finish college
The pair discuss early fitness training days, working out together, and navigating the single life
Bobby recounts encouraging Ahmad to start creating video content years before it became mainstream
Ahmad talks about the strict advice Bobby gave him when he considered moving to Nashville prematurely
Both hosts share personal stories about meeting their wives and experiencing profound changes through fatherhood
Bobby discusses the evolution of his podcast network and the realities of financial success versus early struggle

beschreibung:
Bobby sits down with his longtime friend Ahmad for a trip through more than 20 years of friendship. They argue over how they actually met at a gym in Austin, look back at nights going out when neither of them wanted to admit they weren’t having fun, and remember how their friend group slowly came together. Ahmad shares how Bobby pushed him to finish college, why he wishes he had listened to some of Bobby’s early advice, and the many times Bobby tried to convince him to move to Nashville. They also get into Ahmad’s first impressions of Caitlin, watching Bobby change after meeting her, and what it’s like seeing his longtime friend now as a husband and dad.
